description: This file defines the class CheckPartialPermissionsVisitor, which extends CheckPermissionsVisitor, and is responsible for checking partial permissions within a resource tree in the Eclipse Ditto framework. It constructs with a resource pointer, authorization subject IDs, and expected permissions, and overrides permission aggregation logic based on resource node locations.

classes.name: CheckPartialPermissionsVisitor
classes.description: A final class extending CheckPermissionsVisitor, responsible for evaluating partial permissions on resource nodes based on their position relative to a target pointer.

methods.name: CheckPartialPermissionsVisitor
methods.description: Constructor initializing the visitor with resource pointer, authorized subject IDs, and expected permissions.

methods.name: aggregateWeightedPermissions
methods.description: Overrides parent method to aggregate permissions from resource nodes, adding granted and revoked permissions according to the node's location.
